name: OSPYR·1 CLIENT ACQUISITION BRAIN — 28 sub-automations: capture → qualify → nurture → book

parameters.content:
# 🧲 O1 · CLIENT ACQUISITION BRAIN (28 sub-automations)
**CAPTURE (9):** ① website form ② WhatsApp click ③ IG DM (ManyChat relay) ④ FB lead ad ⑤ LinkedIn email parse ⑥ referral link ⑦ audit-request form ⑧ missed call ⑨ manual add via Telegram `#lead name/phone/niche`.
**QUALIFY (7):** ⑩ AI niche detection ⑪ AI budget-fit score 1-10 ⑫ AI pain extraction ⑬ dedupe by phone ⑭ enrich from website URL fetch ⑮ hot-lead 🔥 alert ⑯ auto-assign next action.
**NURTURE (8):** ⑰ instant intro reply ⑱ day-1 value message ⑲ day-3 case-study ⑳ day-7 audit offer ㉑ day-14 last-touch ㉒ stale-lead AI revival ㉓ personalised pitch line per niche ㉔ one-tap wa.me for every touch.
**BOOK (4):** ㉕ discovery-call webhook → Calendar ㉖ reminder T-2h ㉗ no-show re-book nudge ㉘ post-call AI summary → pipeline stage.

**KEYS:** GEMINI_API_KEY · TG_OSPYR_CHAT · OSPYR_SHEET_ID (tabs: Leads, Touches) · Calendar cred · N8N_BASE_URL.
**HOW:** all captures hit ONE webhook `o-lead-in` (POST {source,name,phone,niche,message,url}); the drip engine runs daily 09:00 computing which touch each lead needs (Touches.LastTouch guards duplicates).
**FIX:** touches repeating → LastTouch column blank; scores generic → fill niche+message on capture.

Return STRICT JSON {niche, score_1_10, pain, pitch_line (1 sentence tailored), next_action}" }] }] }
